content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board has released for the Gujarat Subordinate Services Class-3 (Group-A and Group-B) Combined Competitive Examination. The official 38-page Gujarati notification contains complete department-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age relaxation, fixed pay, reservation provisions, application instructions, examination fee, selection process and preliminary and main examination syllabi. Official Notification Source: GSSSB Official Website Detailed Notification: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026 468/202627.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government . Basic computer knowledge and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi are also required. The prescribed degree must be obtained from a university established or incorporated under the applicable Central or State legislation, a recognized institution or an institution meeting the relevant University Grants Commission provisions. Yes. Applicants must possess basic knowledge of computer applications under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. However, the notification permits candidates who do not currently possess the required computer knowledge certificate to apply. Such candidates must obtain and produce acceptable computer knowledge certification before appointment. The accepted evidence may include a recognized computer course certificate, degree or diploma involving computer studies, or Class 10 or Class 12 qualification with a computer subject, according to the applicable rules. The recruitment notification requires adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both . Candidates should also prepare for the Gujarati language portions of the competitive examination and the descriptive Gujarati paper where applicable.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must be at least 20 years old and not more than 35 years old as on 30 November 2026 , before any applicable upper-age relaxation. Important: Reservation-related benefits are generally restricted to eligible candidates belonging to Gujarat's recognized reserved categories. The notification also specifies conditions where candidates applying against unreserved vacancies cannot claim certain reservation-based age relaxations.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary ranging from Rs. 26,000 to Rs. 49,600 for the first five years , depending on the post. Salary Clarification: The amounts shown above are the fixed monthly remuneration applicable during the initial five-year period. Candidates should not treat them as a guaranteed monthly take-home salary after deductions.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The preliminary examination fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for eligible reserved or concession categories . The notification states that examination fees will be refunded to candidates who appear for the examination. Fee Payment Last Date: 2 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Payment Mode: Online using Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallet through OJAS. Additional transaction charges may apply. Yes. The notification provides for refund of the examination fee to candidates who actually appear for the preliminary examination , through the applicable payment mechanism. Candidates who do not attend the examination are not entitled to this refund. Fees are also not refundable merely because an application is rejected or cancelled. Important: An application is not valid until the required examination fee has been paid successfully. Candidates should retain the payment receipt.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment follows a two-stage competitive examination process: a common preliminary examination and separate main examinations for Group-A and Group-B. Online Application: Candidates register and submit the application through OJAS. Preliminary Examination: A common 150-mark objective examination is conducted for Group-A and Group-B. Shortlisting for Mains: Separate Group-A and Group-B eligibility lists are prepared based on preliminary examination performance. Main Examination: Group-A candidates appear for descriptive papers, while Group-B candidates appear for an objective main examination. Merit List: Final selection lists are prepared using the applicable main examination results, reservation provisions and qualifying standards. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must satisfy the prescribed educational, age, category and other eligibility conditions. GSSSB will shortlist candidates for the main examinations separately for Group-A and Group-B, generally up to seven times the number of category-wise vacancies , based on the prescribed preliminary examination merit process. Preliminary examination marks are used for screening and are not counted toward the final selection merit.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Preliminary Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The common preliminary examination will contain 150 multiple-choice questions for 150 marks , with a duration of 120 minutes. Eligible candidates with disabilities will receive additional examination time according to the notification's provisions, including 20 minutes per hour where applicable.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Group-A Main Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Group-A main examination is descriptive and consists of three papers carrying a combined total of 350 marks. The Gujarati descriptive paper carries 100 marks and includes essay writing, expansion of ideas, précis writing, prose comprehension, press notes, letter writing, discussion articles, reports, translation and Gujarati grammar. The English descriptive paper carries 100 marks and covers essay writing, formal letters, report writing, interpretation of visual information, formal speech, précis writing, reading comprehension, grammar and translation. The General Studies paper carries 150 marks. Its syllabus covers Indian history, Gujarat history, cultural heritage, the Constitution, governance, economy, geography, science, environment, current affairs and other subjects prescribed in Appendix-H of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Group-B Main Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Group-B main examination is an objective-type examination carrying 200 marks with a duration of 120 minutes. The notification prescribes a minimum qualifying standard of 40% for the preliminary and main examinations, including the applicable papers. The qualifying standard cannot be reduced below 40% for any category. Meeting the minimum qualifying standard does not automatically guarantee shortlisting or selection, as the competitive merit cut-off may be higher.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their applications for the Gujarat Subordinate Services Class-3 Group-A and Group-B Combined Competitive Examination through OJAS from 5 November to 30 November 2026. Apply Online: OJAS Gujarat Recruitment Portal 468/202627. Application Start Date: 5 November 2026, 2:00 PM. Last Date: 30 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Fee Payment Last Date: 2 December 2026, 11:59 PM. One Time Registration (OTR) is required before submitting an application. Candidates must complete and confirm their application to obtain the confirmation number.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: OTR registration alone does not constitute submission of the recruitment application. Similarly, an application that has not been confirmed or for which the mandatory fee has not been successfully paid may not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE Photograph and Signature Requirements
content_sections.text: The notification prescribes JPG-format photograph and signature uploads, each not exceeding 15 KB. The photograph must have a white background and display the date on which it was taken. It should not be older than one year as measured against the application closing date. Candidates should retain additional copies of the same photograph for the examination and verification stages.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep their original certificates ready and enter information exactly as recorded in those documents. Bachelor's degree certificate and marksheets. School Leaving Certificate or other accepted age proof. Recognized computer knowledge certificate, where available. SC, ST, SEBC or EWS certificate, if applicable. Valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate for eligible SEBC candidates. Disability certificate, if applicable. Ex-Serviceman certificate, if applicable. Widowhood or other relevant relaxation certificate, if applicable. Relevant sports certificate, if claiming the notified benefit. Recent photograph and signature. OJAS Confirmation Number and application printout. Examination fee payment receipt.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Reservation and Important Eligibility Conditions
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must possess valid certificates issued by the competent authorities. SEBC candidates claiming Non-Creamy Layer status and EWS candidates must meet the relevant certificate validity requirements. Original Gujarat reserved-category status is important for reservation benefits under this recruitment. Candidates belonging to reserved categories from other states should not assume they qualify for the same state reservation concessions. Women reservation is applied within the relevant categories in accordance with Gujarat Government rules. Vacancies not specifically reserved for women are not exclusively reserved for men, and eligible women can compete for them on merit. The detailed notification specifies the applicable disability types and post suitability requirements. Candidates claiming PwBD benefits must meet the disability percentage and certification conditions prescribed for their selected cadre. Special provisions are included for eligible Ex-Servicemen and candidates holding qualifying sports achievements. The notification provides additional merit-related conditions for eligible sports candidates, including a prescribed 5% marks benefit where applicable.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: GSSSB will publish examination schedules and instructions for downloading call letters through its official website and the relevant OJAS facilities. Candidates should preserve their application confirmation number and regularly check official announcements for preliminary and main examination admit cards. Official Website: GSSSB Recruitment Updates

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The supplied Advertisement No. 468/202627 announces 1,237 vacancies, including 243 Group-A and 994 Group-B posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to pay the GSSSB CCE examination fee?
faq.answer: The examination fee must be paid online by 2 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general age limit is 20 to 35 years as on 30 November 2026, with applicable category-wise relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for GSSSB CCE 2.0?
faq.answer: Candidates need a recognized Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, basic computer knowledge and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi.

faq.question: Q6. How many Junior Clerk vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 994 Junior Clerk vacancies under Group-B in the uploaded notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for GSSSB Junior Clerk in 2026?
faq.answer: The notified fixed monthly remuneration for Junior Clerk is Rs. 26,000 for the first five years.

faq.question: Q8. Through which portal can candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates can submit their applications exclusively through the official Online Job Application System (OJAS) portal of the Gujarat government located at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any negative marking in the examinations?
faq.answer: Yes, the preliminary examination includes a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each incorrect or wrong answer submitted by the candidate during the test.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required during the application process?
faq.answer: Candidates need educational qualification certificates, proof of birth date, caste certificates, non-creamy layer certificates for SEBC, income and asset certificates for EWS, and disability certificates if applicable.
